stay_outcomes.more_work: stay; continue the same card under its stop guard
stay_outcomes.needs_owner: stay; present the decision to the owner with a recommendation
stay_outcomes.needs_lead: stay; record what stopped or failed so the lead inspects it
stay_outcomes.needs_skill: stay; practice the missing operation on a disposable copy

move_outcomes.pass: move to the next card named by pass; done when done
move_outcomes.returned: send work back to an earlier card on the track

stages.label: Checks, cold review, and live smoke

nodes.label: Triage
nodes.task: Probe affected KiCad/OS/CLI boundaries first; record root-cause class, affected sibling modules/contracts, and required realistic integration tests.
nodes.pass_when: Triage note records root-cause class, sibling blast radius, and concrete test requirements.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.task: Implement unified clean fix without duplicate parsers or N+1 IPC loops, plus realistic contract tests.
nodes.pass_when: Changes follow AGENTS.md and check_hygiene rules with realistic tests committed or ready.

nodes.label: Tool Checks
nodes.task: Run fail-fast hygiene preflight, workflow audit, dev graph tests, and all unit/integration suites in parallel (release metadata is verified at Release).
nodes.pass_when: Hygiene preflight, workflow audit, dev tests, and all unit/integration suites pass in clean separate Python processes.

nodes.label: Cold Review
nodes.task: Review the full diff since the last release tag; reject band-aids, duplicate parsers, N+1 IPC loops, toy fixtures, and stale claims in README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/ROUTING_NOTES.md, or UPGRADING.md.
nodes.pass_when: Cold reviewer verifies architecture, cross-module contracts, realistic test depth, and doc-drift alignment (README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/ROUTING_NOTES.md, UPGRADING.md) on current code SHA.

nodes.label: Live KiCad Smoke
nodes.task: Check Mac idle state first (never interrupt active KiCad/routing runs); run disposable KiCad 10 IPC smoke if IPC/routing changed.
nodes.pass_when: Mac was idle and disposable KiCad 10 IPC smoke passed (or cleanly skipped when no IPC/routing file changed).

nodes.label: Release
nodes.task: In release mode: bump pyproject.toml version, update UPGRADING.md, run scripts/board_graph_tool.py manifest --version <ver>, commit, tag v<ver>, push origin main + tag, and sync idle Mac checkout. In heal mode (--mode heal): refresh tools/board_graph_tool.json with scripts/board_graph_tool.py manifest --version <current>, commit cleanly ahead of origin/main (no version/tag/UPGRADING bump required), and record pass.
nodes.pass_when: Clean tree passes release_gate (release mode: annotated tag matches HEAD and manifest/pyproject/UPGRADING; heal mode: clean commit ahead of origin/main with matching manifest) and upstream approvals remain current.
